cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You brought soup? I'll cook your dinners all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then when I'm better, I'll fill yours twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll bring them back full, with a bigger freezer. That should put me ahead.

mechanism: A uses expert meal-planning and storage corrections to turn B care during illness into ever-larger reciprocal gifts that restore A lead.
confusable: Ordinary gratitude accepts help or matches it; A must surpass each favour and reinterpret B capacity limit as another chance to give more.
comparison: Shift alternative expands time sacrificed, while food alternative expands prepared meals and storage capacity.
seedUse: Soup, stocked freezer and tiny freezer derive from D43-a; S03 contributes measured portions, storage planning and dimensional instructions.
